name: attachment-remove-touch-phone
description: composer attachment tile on a phone: the remove control is visible at rest and meets the 44px tap floor, and its hit box never covers the thumbnail's centre or a neighbouring tile, so a tap on the image opens the lightbox instead of removing the attachment

mutation.declaration: composer.module.css touch block: .removeSlot { top/right 0; translate(50%, -50%); z-index; opacity: 1 } (rule deleted entirely); separately, .imageTile { margin-top: calc(var(--tap-min) / 2) } deleted
mutation.note: Rule deleted (also the pre-fix code): fails, a tap at the first thumbnail's centre lands on first-remove, not first-open. margin-top deleted: fails, the top edge of the remove control lands on BODY - clipped by the pane-standing wrapper.
